S06-R001.label: Manufacturer name
S06-R001.reason: Names the manufacturer of the radiation measurement instrument that collected the data.

S06-R002.label: Product model designation
S06-R002.reason: Reports the instrument product model separately from its individual identifier.

S06-R003.label: Individual hardware serial number
S06-R003.reason: An instrument identifier may contain a serial number or an asset tag. A value should be labeled serial only when its authority or context supports that interpretation.

S06-R004.label: Persistent System identifier
S06-R004.reason: The instrument identifier concerns the physical unit; the XML ID and document UUID have different scopes. No persistence policy for a general system identifier is established.

ISA-A-CERTIFICATE-TRUST.label: Certificate identity and trust context
ISA-A-CERTIFICATE-TRUST.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-A-CERTIFICATE-TRUST.reason: The document identifies equipment and its results. It defines no certificate issuer, trust chain or permitted credential use for a network connection.

S06-R005.label: Described sensing System / arrangement
S06-R005.reason: Describes the radiation instrument that collected the data and its detectors. This supplies a specialized example of a described sensing system.

S06-R006.label: Network-visible participant
S06-R006.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
S06-R006.reason: An instrument represented in an exchange document need not be an addressable participant on a network.

SAPIENT-F2-FUSION-ROLE.label: Candidate — Hierarchical fusion Node role and aggregated capabilities
SAPIENT-F2-FUSION-ROLE.reason: An analysis may reference multiple measurements. These links do not declare a fusion node, its parent registration or its aggregated capabilities.

S06-R007.label: Physical constituent
S06-R007.locator: N42 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType/RadDetectorInformation; Annex B instrument and detector
S06-R007.reason: The file identifies detectors of the described instrument. Its document structure alone does not establish a mechanical subassembly, nesting depth or containment hierarchy.

S06-R008.label: Connected external equipment
S06-R008.reason: The document can describe multiple detectors. It does not declare the external cabling or connection topology of separately managed equipment.

S06-R009.label: Hosting platform / station context
S06-R009.reason: A state vector can locate either the instrument or a detector. It does not identify an independently described host platform or station.

S06-R010.label: Observing procedure / method
S06-R010.reason: Names and versions of the algorithm that processed radiation data concern analysis. They do not identify an acquisition procedure for every observation.

ISA-A-PARTICIPATION.label: Network participation role and responsibilities
ISA-A-PARTICIPATION.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-A-PARTICIPATION.reason: The exchange schema describes collected data. It supplies no network connection or management-path contract for network participation role and responsibilities.

ISA-A-NETWORK-CONTEXT.label: Network instance and connection context
ISA-A-NETWORK-CONTEXT.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-A-NETWORK-CONTEXT.reason: The exchange schema describes collected data. It supplies no network connection or management-path contract for network instance and connection context.

SOSA-F2-MGMT-PATH.label: Candidate — delegated and independent hardware-management path
SOSA-F2-MGMT-PATH.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
SOSA-F2-MGMT-PATH.reason: The exchange schema describes collected data. It supplies no network connection or management-path contract for delegated and independent hardware-management path.

ISA-A-MEMBER-EXPOSURE.label: Composition member exposure and source attribution
ISA-A-MEMBER-EXPOSURE.reason: A result in the instrument file can identify its contributing detector. External member visibility, capability exposure and interface mediation remain separate.

ISA-A-PARTICIPATION-LIFECYCLE.label: Connection-specific network participation lifecycle
ISA-A-PARTICIPATION-LIFECYCLE.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-A-PARTICIPATION-LIFECYCLE.reason: The exchange schema describes collected data. It supplies no network connection or management-path contract for connection-specific network participation lifecycle.

S06-R011.label: Addressed transducer channel
S06-R011.reason: Spectral channels are bins within detector output. The detector reference identifies its source, without creating a separately addressable transducer channel.

S06-R012.label: Reported output field
S06-R012.reason: The measurement can carry distinctly typed reported fields for counts, dose rate or spectral channels. Instrument and detector state have their own elements.

S06-R013.label: Observed / observable property
S06-R013.reason: Named radiation quantities distinguish the meaning of reported values. Other observed properties and an independent observed-property catalog need their own definitions.

S06-R014.label: Observer / observing System
S06-R014.reason: The file describes the collecting instrument. A spectrum also references the particular detector used. A publisher or file creator has a different role.

S06-R015.label: Performed Observation
S06-R015.reason: A measurement record describes a collection with a start, elapsed duration and acquisition class. A publisher example illustrates the record format only.

SAPIENT-F2-TARGET-CLAIMS.label: Candidate — Detected target taxonomy, behavior and confidence assertions
SAPIENT-F2-TARGET-CLAIMS.reason: An analysis can report the identity of a nuclide and confidence in its identification. This is a domain-specific classification; target behavior is a different assertion.

ISA-C-123.label: Observed atmospheric cloud-layer descriptions
ISA-C-123.reason: The core radiation result types and the published two-element environmental extension define no value for observed atmospheric cloud-layer descriptions.

ISA-C-124.label: Observed atmospheric dew-point temperature
ISA-C-124.reason: The core radiation result types and the published two-element environmental extension define no value for observed atmospheric dew-point temperature.

ISA-C-125.label: Observed atmospheric relative humidity
ISA-C-125.locator: NIST N42SchemaAddin-2020.xsd, HumidityValue; Annex L example
ISA-C-125.reason: The example add-in defines relative humidity at measurement time and place. This is a vendor-namespace extension illustrating a way to carry environmental context.

ISA-C-126.label: Observed atmospheric precipitation category and rate
ISA-C-126.reason: The core radiation result types and the published two-element environmental extension define no value for observed atmospheric precipitation category and rate.

ISA-C-127.label: Observed atmospheric pressure
ISA-C-127.reason: The core radiation result types and the published two-element environmental extension define no value for observed atmospheric pressure.

ISA-C-128.label: Observed atmospheric temperature
ISA-C-128.locator: NIST N42SchemaAddin-2020.xsd, TemperatureValue; Annex L example
ISA-C-128.reason: The example add-in defines ambient temperature in degrees Celsius at measurement time and place. An instance using only the core schema has no such dedicated field.

ISA-C-129.label: Observed atmospheric visibility condition and distance
ISA-C-129.reason: The core radiation result types and the published two-element environmental extension define no value for observed atmospheric visibility condition and distance.

ISA-C-130.label: Observed atmospheric wind category, speed and direction
ISA-C-130.reason: The core radiation result types and the published two-element environmental extension define no value for observed atmospheric wind category, speed and direction.

ISA-C-122.label: Observation-associated geographic shape
ISA-C-122.reason: A source position may be a point, relative location or textual location. This supplies no general polygon or area geometry.

ISA-C-133.label: Observed-entity bearing relative to observer orientation
ISA-C-133.reason: An item or source may have angles relative to an origin. The observer and orientation basis used by the target row require explicit corroboration.

ISA-C-141.label: Reported observer-to-entity distance
ISA-C-141.reason: Distance can be given relative to a stated origin. The origin must identify the observer before interpreting this as observer-to-item range.

ISA-C-149.label: Reported entity impact position
ISA-C-149.reason: Source and measured-item positions have no encoded role as a point of impact.

ISA-C-150.label: Reported entity launch position
ISA-C-150.reason: Source and measured-item positions have no encoded role as a point of launch.

ISA-C-151.label: Observed-entity position at observation
ISA-C-151.reason: A measured item can carry a state vector in a particular measurement with absolute or relative location.

ISA-C-159.label: Observed-entity velocity at observation
ISA-C-159.reason: The measured item may have scalar speed and orientation. Its facing orientation is insufficient to establish the direction of the velocity vector.

ISA-C-131.label: Observed-entity battle-space identifier
ISA-C-131.locator: N42 2020 XSD, RadItemInformationType and document-scoped references
ISA-C-131.reason: Measured-item references identify records within the document. They do not assert a battle-space identifier.

ISA-C-140.label: Human-readable observation comment
ISA-C-140.locator: N42 2020 XSD, Remark, ReqIdComplexObjectType/Remark and RadMeasurementType
ISA-C-140.reason: The common object base allows a human-readable comment attached to a specific measurement.

ISA-C-142.label: Explanation for OTHER event type
ISA-C-142.reason: Free text can explain a record or alarm. No field specifically requires an explanation conditioned on an OTHER event type.

ISA-C-145.label: Reported tactical identity of observed entity
ISA-C-145.reason: A measured item and identified nuclide do not express the tactical affiliation of an observed entity.

ISA-C-146.label: Media resources associated with observation
ISA-C-146.reason: The exchange can include linked or embedded media and associate it with measured items. Item association alone does not link the media to a particular observation event.

ISA-C-147.label: Reported primary event-generation method
ISA-C-147.reason: The algorithm can be attributed to the analysis that produced results or alarms. A general event-generation method vocabulary is not defined.

ISA-C-160.label: Attributed verifier of event contents
ISA-C-160.reason: The organization that created the document and the algorithm creator have defined roles. Neither field designates a verifier of a reported event.

ISA-C-134.label: Reported biological contour-level map
ISA-C-134.reason: Radiation counts, doses, spectra and nuclide analysis supply no defined reported biological contour-level map field.

ISA-C-135.label: Detailed reported biological analysis levels
ISA-C-135.reason: Radiation counts, doses, spectra and nuclide analysis supply no defined detailed reported biological analysis levels field.

ISA-C-136.label: Reported biological sample-analysis reading
ISA-C-136.reason: Radiation counts, doses, spectra and nuclide analysis supply no defined reported biological sample-analysis reading field.

ISA-C-137.label: Reported chemical contour-level map
ISA-C-137.reason: Radiation counts, doses, spectra and nuclide analysis supply no defined reported chemical contour-level map field.

ISA-C-138.label: Detailed reported chemical analysis levels
ISA-C-138.reason: Radiation counts, doses, spectra and nuclide analysis supply no defined detailed reported chemical analysis levels field.

ISA-C-139.label: Reported chemical sample-analysis reading
ISA-C-139.reason: Radiation counts, doses, spectra and nuclide analysis supply no defined reported chemical sample-analysis reading field.

ISA-C-144.label: Reported hazard areas associated with an event
ISA-C-144.reason: An alarm can refer to a detector and an analysis can locate a source. These definitions do not delineate a geographic hazard area.

ISA-C-148.label: Reported nuclear-event descriptive information
ISA-C-148.reason: Radiation measurements and nuclide identifications might inform a nuclear-event report. The format does not itself assert a nuclear event or describe its phenomenology.

ISA-C-153.label: Reported radiation contour map
ISA-C-153.reason: Individual source positions, dose estimates and extrema do not form a radiation contour map.

ISA-C-154.label: Reported detailed radiation analysis levels
ISA-C-154.reason: Nuclide identity, category and identification confidence overlap the classified result in ISA-OBS-154. N42 also distinguishes count statistics and dose estimates. ISA’s arbitrary levels and readings cannot be assigned the same units by inference.

ISA-C-155.label: Reported radiation reading
ISA-C-155.locator: N42 2020 XSD, RadMeasurementType/DoseRate, TotalDose; NuclideType/NuclideName, NuclideActivityValue; ISA-OBS-155
ISA-C-155.reason: Identified nuclide and activity overlap. N42 dose fields measure ambient dose equivalent in microsieverts or microsieverts per hour. ISA also allows absorbed dose in gray; these are different quantities.

ISA-C-132.label: Inferred past observation statements
ISA-C-132.reason: Computed products can cite earlier measurements. Processing those measurements does not by itself establish a backcast about a past state.

ISA-C-143.label: Forecast observation statements
ISA-C-143.reason: Defined derived and analytical results describe collected radiation data. They do not represent a forecast time and predicted observation.

ISA-C-152.label: Processed video-frame report
ISA-C-152.reason: Media dimensions, perspective and capture time are represented; a video-frame processing result and frame-analysis fields are not established.

ISA-C-156.label: Referenced-event recall reason
ISA-C-156.reason: Alarm description and analysis status do not encode withdrawal of an earlier event and a reason.

ISA-C-157.label: Referenced-event resolution reason
ISA-C-157.reason: Alarm description and analysis status do not encode resolution of an earlier event and a reason.

ISA-C-158.label: Observed solar irradiance
ISA-C-158.reason: The core radiation result types and the published two-element environmental extension define no value for observed solar irradiance.

ISA-T-EVENT-ID.label: Source-qualified event identity and reference
ISA-T-EVENT-ID.reason: Alarm identity, event time and detector references are distinguishable. An optional document-local ID does not guarantee an event key scoped by a creating network participant.

ISA-T-EVENT-TIME.label: Event occurrence time
ISA-T-EVENT-TIME.reason: An issued radiation alarm can carry the date and time of the alarm.

ISA-T-EVENT-REASON.label: Event creation category
ISA-T-EVENT-REASON.reason: The category classifies an issued radiation alarm; the measurement class identifies a kind of acquisition. Neither field states a generic reason for creating an exchange event.

ISA-T-EVENT-CONTEXT.label: Detector property context at event occurrence
ISA-T-EVENT-CONTEXT.reason: A measurement may carry characteristics and state for the referenced detector at acquisition. This does not imply that the values differ from the last status message.

ISA-R-MEASUREMENT.label: Reported value and associated uncertainty
ISA-R-MEASUREMENT.reason: Values and their uncertainties are separately defined for particular radiation quantities. Each uncertainty must retain its subject and stated units.

ISA-R-VIDEO-DETECTION.label: Video-frame detection details
ISA-R-VIDEO-DETECTION.reason: Media metadata and nuclide identification confidence do not define a video-frame bounding rectangle or track association.

ISA-R-VIDEO-TRACK.label: Video-derived entity track reference
ISA-R-VIDEO-TRACK.reason: A link from media to measured items is not a video-derived track identifier.

ISA-K-CAPABILITIES.label: Declared component capability catalogue
ISA-K-CAPABILITIES.reason: The schema records instrument and detector descriptions and characteristics. No manifest of supported properties, commands and custom structures is defined.

SAPIENT-F2-PERFORMANCE.label: Candidate — Declared detection performance and geometric error
SAPIENT-F2-PERFORMANCE.reason: Accuracy for a particular point and a minimum detectable activity in a nuclide analysis are context-specific evidence. They do not declare the instrument’s registered detection performance envelope.

ISA-K-PROPERTY-DECL.label: Declared property definition
ISA-K-PROPERTY-DECL.reason: A reported characteristic can carry name, value, units and data class. The format does not require an independent device declaration with validity and publication rules.

ISA-K-OBSERVABLE-DECL.label: Declared observable definition
ISA-K-OBSERVABLE-DECL.reason: A schema names allowed radiation results and a detector category. An instance does not thereby advertise every observable the device supports.

ISA-K-COMMAND-DECL.label: Declared command interface
ISA-K-COMMAND-DECL.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-K-COMMAND-DECL.reason: The file format supplies no instrument control contract for declared command interface.

ISA-K-PARAMETER-DECL.label: Declared command parameter
ISA-K-PARAMETER-DECL.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-K-PARAMETER-DECL.reason: The file format supplies no instrument control contract for declared command parameter.

ISA-K-RESULT-DECL.label: Declared command result
ISA-K-RESULT-DECL.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-K-RESULT-DECL.reason: The file format supplies no instrument control contract for declared command result.

ISA-K-CUSTOM-TYPE.label: Declared custom data structure
ISA-K-CUSTOM-TYPE.locator: NIST add-in XSD, HumidityValue and TemperatureValue substitutions for RadMeasurementExtension; primary XSD extension elements
ISA-K-CUSTOM-TYPE.reason: An author may define an extension in a separate namespace via an XML schema. This is schema-level extensibility; an individual device need not transmit a custom-type declaration.

ISA-K-FIELD-DECL.label: Declared field within a custom structure
ISA-K-FIELD-DECL.locator: NIST add-in XSD, HumidityValue and TemperatureValue; primary XSD RadMeasurementType/RadMeasurementExtension
ISA-K-FIELD-DECL.reason: A schema extension gives its field a name, type, role and documentation. These field definitions reside in the schema rather than being declared by the reporting component.

ISA-K-TYPE-CHOICE.label: Declared built-in or custom value type
ISA-K-TYPE-CHOICE.locator: N42 2020 XSD, CharacteristicValueDataClassCode, ChannelDataType; add-in XSD TemperatureValue/@type
ISA-K-TYPE-CHOICE.reason: Schema-defined types coexist with XML built-in types. A reported characteristic can identify its value class, without a device negotiating or declaring a new type.

ISA-K-STRUCTURE.label: Declared value shape and collection bounds
ISA-K-STRUCTURE.reason: Schema occurrence constraints describe repeatable results and list-valued channel data. A device does not declare runtime tree-depth or collection limits in this record.

ISA-K-VALUE-RANGE.label: Declared permitted or excluded values
ISA-K-VALUE-RANGE.locator: N42 2020 XSD, Angle90Type, Angle180Type and associated simple types
ISA-K-VALUE-RANGE.reason: The schema constrains some angular values and uses enumerations for coded fields. It does not describe a component publishing its own range or exclusions.

ISA-K-MUTABILITY.label: Declared property mutability
ISA-K-MUTABILITY.locator: NIST N42.42 project, Description; 2020 XSD, RadInstrumentDataType
ISA-K-MUTABILITY.reason: The file format supplies no instrument control contract for declared property mutability.

ISA-K-ABS-THRESHOLD.label: Absolute-value publication threshold
ISA-K-ABS-THRESHOLD.reason: An issued alarm or out-of-limits flag is evidence about a result. It does not define absolute-value publication threshold for property publication.

ISA-K-REL-THRESHOLD.label: Relative-change publication threshold and reference basis
ISA-K-REL-THRESHOLD.reason: An issued alarm or out-of-limits flag is evidence about a result. It does not define relative-change publication threshold and reference basis for property publication.

ISA-K-THRESHOLDS.label: Declared property publication triggers
ISA-K-THRESHOLDS.reason: An issued alarm or out-of-limits flag is evidence about a result. It does not define declared property publication triggers for property publication.

S06-R017.label: Declared default mode

S06-R018.label: Source-reported operating mode
